fields.label: Title
fields.name: cpt_work_title
fields.instructions: Enter the title of the work item - this will appear as the title on the card and in the banner on the detail page.

fields.label: Highlight Statistic
fields.name: cpt_work_highlight_statistic
fields.instructions: Enter the statistic you want to highlight. This will be displayed in the card.

fields.label: Company Size
fields.name: cpt_work_company_size
fields.instructions: Enter the company size. Eg. SME

fields.label: URL
fields.name: cpt_work_url
fields.instructions: Enter the URL of the work item. Eg. https://thewave.com

fields.label: Video
fields.name: cpt_work_video
fields.instructions: Enter the URL of the video you want to display on the detail page. This displays prominently at the top of the page.

fields.label: Card Image
fields.name: cpt_work_card_image
fields.instructions: Select the image that will be used on the card. Note this should be a transparent PNG for best results.

fields.label: Hide from Archive
fields.name: cpt_work_hide_from_archive
fields.instructions: Select this option to hide the work item from the archive page.

fields.label: Hide Single page
fields.name: cpt_work_hide_single_page
fields.instructions: Select this option to hide the work items single page. This will throw a 404 on the detail page and serve a url in the industries block instead.
